channel.title: Lake & McHenry County Scanner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lake & McHenry County Scanner (lakemchenryscanner.com)

item.title: Three seriously injured after semi-truck jackknifes on Route 12 near Fox Lake due to snowstorm
item.description: Three people were seriously injured after a semi-truck jackknifed on Route 12 near Fox Lake in the heavy snowfall on Saturday, hitting a pickup truck and two other vehicles before coming to a stop.

item.title: Marengo man injured after hand gets hit by snowblower blades, authorities said
item.description: A Marengo man was injured Saturday after his hand was hit by the blades of a snowblower, authorities said.

item.title: Man wanted on active warrant found with cocaine packaged for sale, cash in McHenry County
item.description: An Elgin man has been denied release from McHenry County jail after officers arrested him with more than 32 grams of cocaine in his possession, authorities said.

item.title: Several inches of snow expected Monday in Chicagoland area after snowstorm dumped foot of snow over weekend
item.description: More snow is expected in the Chicagoland area during the Monday rush hour commute following a snowstorm over the post-Thanksgiving weekend that dumped a foot of snow in Lake and McHenry counties.

item.title: 2nd suspect charged as adult in violent carjacking of pregnant mother whose child was abducted near Libertyville
item.description: A second suspect, who is also facing separate shooting charges, has been charged as an adult in a violent carjacking of a pregnant mother who was run over and had her child abducted near Libertyville.

item.title: No injuries reported after police squad crashes into tow truck along Route 14 in Cary
item.description: No citations were issued after a Cary police squad pulled out in front of a tow truck and caused a crash on Route 14 in Cary while en route to a call, officials said.

item.title: Firefighters rescue multiple animals, 1 missing after fire causes heavy damage to house in Huntley
item.description: Firefighters rescued multiple animals from a fire that caused heavy damage to a house, leaving the residents displaced, in Huntley Monday morning as the search continues for a missing pet.

item.title: Prosecutors say woman fired multiple shots, hitting partner as he walked away from her at Gurnee hotel
item.description: Prosecutors say a woman opened fire on her partner, leaving him wounded, as he walked away from her outside a hotel in Gurnee before hovering over him while pointing the gun at him as he lay injured.

item.title: Mayor fires back after city alderwoman questions donor recognition signs at free community ice rink in McHenry
item.description: The mayor of McHenry is firing back at an alderwoman who questioned why signs were posted on a community ice rink in recognition of families and businesses who donated their time and resources to build it.

item.title: Young child injured in school bus crash that left students, driver trapped due to live power lines near McHenry
item.description: A young child was injured after a school bus crash that left students and the driver temporarily trapped on the bus due to live power lines near McHenry Monday afternoon.
